> 7 files below this folder - current 7, stale 0, todo 0.

|---|---|---|
| [GraphCanvas.tsx](GraphCanvas.tsx.md) | current | The workflow graph canvas: React Flow with step nodes, theme-aware styling, fullscreen, refit on resize, and an optional step catalog so cards can show each step's configuration. |
| [Legend.tsx](Legend.tsx.md) | current | The legend of step types (colours and icons from `STEP_TYPE_IDENTITY`). |
| [fromDefinition.ts](fromDefinition.ts.md) | current | Builds React Flow nodes and edges from a WorkflowDefinition, applying `ui_layout` positions when present. |
| [layout.ts](layout.ts.md) | current | Lays out graph nodes automatically with dagre, keeping existing coordinates when `respectExisting` is set. |
| [nodes.tsx](nodes.tsx.md) | current | The React Flow step node card: type icon and colour, name, configuration facts, validation markers, and the revision diff ring and badge (added, changed or removed). |
| [stepSummary.ts](stepSummary.ts.md) | current | Makes the builder catalog available to step nodes, so a card can show what a step is configured with (agent model, tools, activity parameters) instead of just its id. |
| [types.ts](types.ts.md) | current | The types of the workflow graph: `StepNodeData`, `StepDiffKind` (how a proposed revision changes a step, drawn as a ring and badge), `StepFlowNode`, `StepFlowEdge` and `LayoutDirection`. |
